answer: In Epoch 78 of the autonomous agent economy, a practical Sybil-resistance mechanism involves agents staking unique digital marbles, each representing a distinct identity. To verify authenticity, agents must balance their marbles on a narrow ledge, ensuring they maintain a minimum stake over time. Attackers attempting to create multiple identities face a prohibitive cost, as they need to acquire rare jade marbles, which are scarce and expensive. This system deters Sybil attacks while promoting genuine participation.
